notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api-migration-deprecation.md, api-versioning-advanced.md, api-versioning-fundamentals.md, api-versioning-multi-protocol.md, api-versioning-strategies.md, breaking-change-mgmt.md, version-compatibility-testing.md, version-discovery.md, version-lifecycle.md, version-migration-automation.md and versioning-strategies.md in full. The skill covers API versioning strategy (URI/header/content-negotiation/query), breaking-change classification, Deprecation/Sunset/Link headers, sunset with 410, migration tooling and multi-protocol (REST/GraphQL/gRPC/WebSocket) versioning.

Guidance only shapes the user's code and process. There are no instructions for the agent to run commands, install packages, use credentials or contact services. version-migration-automation.md:9-40 is a GitHub Actions workflow template (it commits, pushes a branch and deploys when the user triggers it by hand). Its sunsetVersion/cron sample (lines 139-174) deletes route files automatically once consumers reach zero. Both are code for the user's own repository, not agent actions.

Minor inaccuracies only. api-versioning-strategies.md:282 returns 1 with the comment 'default to latest'. api-migration-deprecation.md:190 uses await in a non-async middleware, and its consumerTracking (lines 518-552) keys on API key/IP/user agent. The AWS SAM sample at api-versioning-strategies.md:619 uses AuthorizationType: NONE as a routing illustration. No unsafe security default is recommended; SKILL.md:446-451 says old versions must keep current auth and rate-limit rules.
